name: Struggles with Inner Monstrosity
description: You harbor a monstrous alter ego, struggling to control the beast within while utilizing its power.
connectionOptions: One PC has seen your monstrous form and kept your secret.
You're seeking a cure, and one PC might have leads.
One PC reminds you of someone from your past, before your transformation.
You fear you might have harmed one PC's loved one during a loss of control.
additionalEquipment: Locket with a picture of your former self

abilities.name: Monstrous Strength
abilities.description: When you embrace your inner beast, you gain +2 to your Might Edge for 10 minutes, but risk losing control.

abilities.name: Heightened Senses
abilities.description: You're trained in perception tasks, particularly those involving smell or hearing.

abilities.name: Rapid Healing
abilities.description: You heal at an accelerated rate, recovering 1 additional point per hour to your Might Pool.

abilities.name: Partial Transformation
abilities.description: You can partially transform specific body parts (e.g., claws, enhanced muscles) without full transformation.

abilities.name: Primal Rage
abilities.description: When seriously injured, you can enter a berserk state, gaining +1 Armor and dealing +3 damage in combat, but attacking friend and foe alike.

abilities.name: Beast Mastery
abilities.description: You gain limited control over your monstrous form, retaining your mind during transformation and gaining its full benefits without drawbacks once per day.

abilities.name: Monstrous Apotheosis
abilities.description: Once per session, you can fully embrace your monstrous nature, gaining immense power but risking permanent transformation. Work with the GM to determine specific effects.
